player_0.content: New plan: I failed to visit the "Sauna" room again after leaving it, and I did not explore the "south" direction from the Gallery, leaving unvisited rooms. I treated the graph edges as static and did not update them when returning to a room or discovering new connections. Next time, I will maintain a strict list of visited rooms and only move to a direction if the target room is not in my visited list. I will also ensure the graph's "nodes" list is updated every time I enter a new room and the "edges" list is updated to reflect the current location's connections before sending the "DONE" command.
